completion:
Finish with the time records.

When a reportable accident happens, the employer may be required to fill out a Form 5020.09 (Accident Report Worksheet & Reportable Employment Incident) or Form 5020.10 (Reportable Employment Incident and Accident Report Worksheet Accident Involving Death), and will be required to keep on file a copy of the workers' compensation report Form5010.044 (First Report of and Order for Compensation or Form 5026.120 (Industry Development and Assessment). Reportable accidents for employers electing UI coverage only, these forms will not be required.

In deciding whether to fill out Form 5020.09 or Form 5020.10, these following items are helpful;
